text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN SALE - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation bought 37,500 tonnes of Chinese corn Saturday at $141.90 a tonne, C and F, an association official said. It bought three 12,500-tonne cargoes from Toepfer. Arrival for the first cargo was set by April 25, the second by May 5 and the third by May 30 to the port of Kunsan.

WHEAT SALE - Australia sold 200,000 tonnes of wheat to India for March delivery, the Australian Wheat Board said in its weekly grain report. "This latest sale increases our total sales to India this season to around 1.3 million tonnes, more than three quarters of the total 1.7 million tonnes India is reported to have purchased this year," the AWB said.
CORN TENDER - Taiwan's CK group will tender on Tuesday for two 54,000 tonne shipments of U.S. No.2 or Argentine corn for April/May shipment, traders said.
- The Cyprus Grain Commission will tender until February 25 for 18,000 tonnes of maize, with shipment in March 1997.

WHEAT TENDERS - The Taiwan Flour Mills Association should tender Thursday for two shipments totalling 69,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, Taipei traders said. The first shipment is for March 15 to April 5 from the Pacific Northwest (PNW), the second for March 31 to April 20 from the PNW, traders said.

- The European Union was scheduled to tender February 25 to supply 45,000 tonnes of EU soft wheat as food aid to Bangladesh, France's grain office ONIC said. The EU will hold another tender that day to supply Ivory Coast with 2,480 tonnes of EU maize flour as food aid, it said.

WHEAT TENDERS - The Commodity Credit Corp seeks 10,530 tonnes US hard red wheat Feb 26 for Bangladesh. It seeks 5,870 tonnes of hard red winter wheat and 4,660 HRW or hard red spring for March 15-April 10 shipment.
SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan BSPA's Taichung Division seeks 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans Tuesday, traders said.

CORN, RICE, CORN/SOY BLEND TENDER - The CCC said it seeks 32,380 tonnes U.S. corn, rice and corn/soy blend for North Korea. It seeks 5,000 tonnes of corn-soy blend, 20,780 yellow corn and 6,600 milled rice. Delivery was for April 1 and offers were due February 25.

VEGOIL SALES - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said it seeks to buy up to 35,000 tonnes of vegetable oils for delivery in first half April. It seeks 20,000 to 25,000 tonnes of raw sunflower oil, semi-refined cottonseed oil and/or U.S. cottonseed oil of 162 degrees, and 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soy oil, any origin. The deadline for bids is March 5.

MARKET TALK - China has decided to ship three million tonnes of corn from northeastern producing regions to the high-consuming south, the third time in six months, official media said on Sunday. The corn would be shipped from northeastern Heilongjiang, Jilin and Liaoning provinces and the Inner Mongolia region, the official Grain and Oil Market Daily said in an edition seen in Beijng on Sunday.
... The USDA granted Jordan a $21 million soft loan under the export credit program of PL-480, a Jordanian official said.
